title: Confidant
subtitle: A privacy-first desktop AI that runs entirely on-device.

tracks.title: Title
tracks.about: Confidant — A privacy-first desktop AI that runs entirely on-device.

tracks.title: Problem
tracks.about: Cloud AI breaks trust; users need privacy and control. Making local AI feel trustworthy; designing for slower inference; mental model clarity.

tracks.title: Insight
tracks.about: Trust must be designed in — transparency and user ownership are core to adoption.

tracks.title: Approach
tracks.about: Fully local, transparent, user-owned. No data leaves the device; inference and storage on-device.

tracks.title: Architecture
tracks.about: Stack: React, TypeScript, Tauri, Rust; local LLM integration; ChromaDB; end-to-end implementation.

tracks.title: UX challenges
tracks.about: Designing for slower inference; mental model clarity; desktop-native patterns.

tracks.title: Design System
tracks.about: Design system — tokens, components, structure; consistency and scalability; desktop-native patterns.

tracks.title: Engineering & implementation
tracks.about: React, TypeScript, Tauri, Rust; local LLM integration; ChromaDB; production desktop app.

tracks.title: Outcome
tracks.about: Viable local-first AI model, production desktop app, integrated design system and architecture.
